Summary of Position

Responsible for translating, implementing and operationalizing the product strategy across all employer-facing lines of business: Large Group Fully Insured (LG FI), Small Group Fully Insured (SG FI), ASO/Self-Insured, Level Funded in addition to joint / shared administration arrangements and Ancillary products.

Support the organization's strategy to grow FI, Self-Funded and Level Funded membership, modernize its administration platform, compete for joint-administration accounts, and launch innovative large group product capabilities the market expects.

Maintain and enhance the existing employer book, redesign the administration model for scalability and compliance, drive joint administration implementation with TPA and co-carrier partners, support the build and implementation of new ASO capabilities and lead the FI and ancillary product platforms.

Responsible for translating the department’s Employer Segment’s business priorities into market-ready, financially sound and operationally executable product designs and for holding the team accountable for on-time delivery, regulatory readiness and product quality across the full employer book.

Partner with sales leadership in client facing presentations serving as the product subject matter expert who fields questions and articulates technical and operational details in real time.

Principal Accountabilities

Drive product delivery and implementation of the employer segment strategy across LG FI, SG FI, ASO/Self-Insured, Level Funded and Ancillary products. Define the multi-year product roadmap aligned to GM’s P&L priorities, growth targets and competitive positioning.

Lead ASO product management and operations with deep subject matter expertise in self-funded employee benefits. Define ASO standard vs. non-standard product guardrails and value proposition and shape the service model in partnership with the areas that own its components (admin services, reporting, stop loss, care management).

Responsible for benefit design standards and regulatory filing strategy for the employer book. Set medical benefit templates, plan structures and network configurations for LG FI and SG FI. Ensure all employer products are rate-able, DFS compliant, and aligned with actuarial pricing assumptions.

Lead, develop and hold accountable a team (ASO Products, FI & SG Products, Ancillary). Set clear role expectations, provide coaching and development, conduct performance reviews and build a high-performing product team capable of executing across all employer LOBs.

Partner with the GM, Employer Segment and Sales leadership to translate employer market priorities into clear product direction. Support RFP responses, broker strategy and account-level product decisions. Bring product expertise into go-to-market conversations and ensure the Sales team is equipped with competitive, accurate product positioning.

Collaborate on employer product growth efforts. Identify opportunities across ASO and LG expansion, SG retention, and ancillary product to deepen product penetration within the existing employer book, driving greater adoption of ancillary lines alongside the core medical plan in partnership with sales and account management.

Coordinate cross-functionally across Actuary, Legal, Compliance, IT, Network, Operations, Communications and more to move products from design to launch-ready state. Serve as the primary decision-maker and escalation point for employer product issues. Represent the employer product function in executive forums, and regulatory discussions.

Qualifications

Education, Training, Licenses, Certifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Health Administration, Public Health, Finance or related field required.

Master's degree (MBA, MHA, MPH) strongly preferred.

Relevant Work Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

10 – 12+ years of progressive experience in health insurance product management. (Required)

5+ years’ experience at a director or senior leadership level. (Required)

Deep ASO/self-funded product expertise is required. Candidates must demonstrate hands-on experience designing and managing ASO product platforms, service models, stop-loss structures and employer-specific configurations in a regulated health plan environment. (Required)

Fully Insured product experience across Large Group and/or Small Group markets, including benefit design, ACA compliance, DFS filing requirements and community rating rules in New York. (Required)

Proven experience leading a team of product professionals. Demonstrated ability to hire, develop and hold accountable a team of Leaders or Senior Managers. (Required)

Strong cross-functional partnership skills. Track record of successful collaboration with Actuarial, Sales, Legal, Compliance, Network and Operations functions in a health plan. (Required)

Regulatory knowledge of New York market requirements (DFS, ACA, ERISA, NYS DFS rate filing processes). (Required)

Ancillary product experience (Dental, Vision, Rx). (Preferred)

Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written. Ability to present product strategy clearly to executive leadership, Sales leadership and external stakeholders. (Required)

Senior Product Manager for Mobile Payment:

Samsung Wallet is a mobile payment service and digital wallet developed by Samsung. It is designed to be a one-stop shop for all debit cards, credit cards, digital passes, and tickets, making them easy to access and use when necessary. With the rise of NFC payment terminals in stores and evolving consumer preferences over the past year, Samsung Wallet has never been more important. Working on the Samsung Wallet team will give you a chance to make a significant impact on the lives of millions of people around the world, and will be invaluable to the future of payments and financial services. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with and learn from experts from a variety of fields, as well as work on exciting, challenging projects.

Position Summary:

We are seeking Senior Product Manager (PM) to lead the development and execution of product strategies within its ecosystem. The candidate will work from our office in New York, while collaborating closely with our decision makers based at Samsung’s headquarters in South Korea, and engineering teams based in Korea and elsewhere across the globe. This role requires comfort with a globally distributed team structure and the ability to navigate international cultures and time zones.

As a Product Manager, you will contribute to the roadmap of one or more product areas within the Samsung Wallet ecosystem, define and articulate use cases, driving product and technical requirements through discussions with internal and external stakeholders, and execute on those requirements by collaborating with a geographically dispersed engineering team. In the course of your work, you may also be required to coordinate schedules, dependencies, and cross-functional readiness (e.g., contracts, marketing, beta testing, customer service). Role and Responsibilities

Define and articulate use cases and requirements for features within Samsung Wallet.
Own and drive product and technical requirements for core payment experiences include card registration, in-store and online payments, and Samsung branded card offerings.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product Management, Business, Engineering, Marketing) across US, Korea, Philippines, India and other regions to ensure timely project delivery.
Drive product and technical requirements through discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
Manage project schedules, track and report issues, and negotiate release dates as required.
Manage cross-functional readiness (e.g., contracts, marketing, beta testing) to ensure seamless execution.
Create product concepts, competitive analysis, and collateral materials (FAQ, CS training, overview documents etc.,) for feature launches.
Regularly update stakeholders on project status and analytical dashboards.
Juggle between multiple projects, make optimal use of engineering bandwidth, prioritize among feature requests by validating the business case, partner readiness and other levers.

Engineering Background: Degree in CS, EE, or similar field, with 7+ years of IT industry experience, including 5+ years in Product Management.
Experience in large-scale mobile-first applications and services, in payments, tokenization or wallet-related domains.
Strong technical depth to articulate product choices and defend feature definitions and priorities.
Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence) and data analysis/visualization tools (e.g., Excel, Tableau).
Ability to influence across the business and engineering without authority and align with global HQ direction.
Take on project management aspects where required, to ensure timely delivery.
Comfort working with a geographically dispersed team, including travel for partner meetings or stakeholder engagements.

Job Description

Champions the prioritization of products and features by evaluating business value, feasibility, and user needs, ensuring alignment with Oracle's goals and strategies. Leads the engagement of key strategic customers, non-customers, partners and industry analysts to obtain market information and discover opportunities for product portfolio/product area. Establishes strategies to identify customer needs and market opportunities, guiding teams to develop highly complex solutions and validate them. Provides strategic guidance to team members on maintaining the roadmap for multiple products/features, drives delivery excellence, and fosters a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. Acts as an innovation leader within the Line of Business (LOB) and sets the overall strategy and direction of products, driving initiatives and setting the long-term vision. Champions the adoption of new methodologies for new feature development. Drives the sharing of strategic insights with cross-functional partners and Lines of Business (LOB). Owns transformative business impact across LOB and oversees standards of success metrics criteria and performance metrics (e.g., OKRs, KPIs) for multiple products. Champions the customer's needs throughout the product lifecycle and prioritizes critical customer issues. Proactively seeks out customers to gather feedback and align product capabilities with highly valued customers' business goals. Leads the go-to-market efforts, strategically recruits and supports key early adopters, and defines and tracks product adoption metrics for multiple product lines to drive adoption and product improvement.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Product Analysis – Market Analysis:

–Champions the prioritization of products/features based on evaluations of business value, feasibility, and internal and/or external user needs.

–Works with highly valued customers to ensure seamless alignment between the customer, the market, internal stakeholders, and Oracle's goals and strategy.

–Champions the analysis of market trends and the competitive landscape to set strategic and competitive positioning.

–Leads the engagements of key strategic customers, non-customers, partners, and industry analysts to obtain market information and discover opportunities for the product portfolio/product area.

Product Analysis – Solution Identification:

–Establishes strategies for identifying customers' unmet or unknown needs, market opportunities, and regulatory requirements.

–Influences internal teams in developing problem statements for highly complex products and forming data-driven hypotheses for breakthrough new products.

–Owns and champions the solutioning process by strategically partnering with internal and external stakeholders to identify solutions.

–Spearheads the evaluation and validation of different solutions to make informed decisions on enhancing existing products/features or introducing new products/features.

–Leads the creation and maintenance of critical and complex solution artifacts (e.g., regulatory requirements, functional and non-functional requirements).

Product Ownership – Product Development and Roadmapping:

–Drives the Line of Business’s (LOB) product lifecycle approach, setting industry standards for excellence.

–Provides strategic guidance to team members on maintaining the roadmap for multiple products/features, aligning them with Oracle’s vision and market demands.

–Establishes feature requirements, resources, and best practices, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and empowering internal stakeholders.

–Takes a leadership role in driving delivery excellence with key stakeholders, managing risks and resolving complex issues to ensure project success.

–Interprets existing metrics (e.g., Service Requests, bugs raised, customer feedback, customer volumes) and market insights, driving strategic decision-making and optimizing product development in dynamic environments.

–Sets expectations for product quality by leading the creation and review of user stories and acceptance criteria.

–Reviews and shapes features or experiences prioritized in the roadmap, strategically aligning them with success criteria and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).

Product Ownership – Product Leadership and Influence:

–Acts as an innovation leader within the Line of Business (LOB) and sets the overall strategy and direction of products, driving initiatives and long-term vision.

–Directs the development of products to deliver exceptional customer experiences and achieve business goals.

–Champions the adoption of new methodologies for new feature development, leveraging agile and continuous-delivery practices.

Alignment and Collaboration:

–Drives the sharing of strategic insights with cross-functional partners and Lines of Business (LOB), ensuring alignment and fostering a culture of collaboration.

–Anticipates and addresses potential pushback from stakeholders, leveraging extensive subject matter expertise and data-driven arguments to drive consensus and decision-making.

–Guides collaboration efforts with engineering and senior colleagues to execute innovative solutions tied to OKRs and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

–Takes full ownership of driving transformative business impact across Lines of Business (LOB), overseeing success criteria and performance metrics (e.g., OKRs, KPIs) for multiple products/features.

–Provides insight into parameters for user testing and champions the iteration and enhancement of products based on test results.

Customer-Centricity:

–Champions the customer's needs throughout the product lifecycle, proactively anticipating and addressing complex customer needs.

–Proactively seeks out customers to gather comprehensive feedback and conducts extensive research to understand their experiences with Oracle's products and services.

–Collaborates strategically with highly valued customers to align Oracle product capabilities with customers' evolving business goals.

–Leads efforts to capture, analyze, and synthesize intricate customer requirements, defining new product capabilities and driving the development of feature designs.

–Provides subject matter expertise and guidance to ensure products deliver exceptional value and exceed product consumer expectations following implementations.

–Reviews and prioritizes critical customer issues to ensure customer satisfaction and product quality, partnering with product development for advanced resolution.

Product Release – Go-to-Market:

–Leads the development of release overviews, field presentations, and demos for the field team, providing guidance to junior staff as needed.

–Strategically recruits and provides robust support to key early adopters to validate and enhance product solutions.

–Drives the development of thorough and detailed user documentation, providing expert-level oversight as needed.

–Defines and tracks key product metrics to monitor adoption for multiple product lines, leveraging data insights to drive product improvement.

–Presents product demonstrations to highly valued internal and/or external customers and partners, industry analysts, and field teams, showcasing the innovation and value of new releases.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

–Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements.

–Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

–Influences cross-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives.

–Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success.

–Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

–Leads specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues.

–Guides others to leverage innovative data-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drive the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues.

Continuous Learning:

–Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise to serve as a thought leader within the organization.

–Contributes to the advancement of the field or industry through thought leadership (e.g., conference presentations, white papers, research contributions).

–Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices.

–Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams.

–Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

Continuous Improvement:

–Develops innovative solutions and drives the implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization.

–Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals.

–Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.

Performance and Development:

About Us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About The Role

Understanding cyber risk at internet scale is a difficult product problem. The data must be broad enough to identify meaningful exposures, accurate enough to support important decisions, and timely enough to be useful when it matters. It also needs to be presented in ways that different users can understand and act on.

As Product Manager, Scanning & Risk Data, you will bring a product perspective to this challenge. You will connect the technical systems that collect and process security data with the people and products that use it. You will set priorities, clarify trade-offs, and help Coalition build a more accurate, scalable, and actionable view of cyber risk.

What You'll Own

The product strategy for Coalition's scanning and risk-data capabilities.
How we discover and understand a company's digital assets, technologies, vulnerabilities, and security posture.
The quality, accuracy, timeliness, and usability of the data produced by our scanning systems.
The experiences, APIs, and data products that make risk information useful to underwriters, security teams, analysts, and customers.
The balance between coverage, precision, speed, reliability, and cost as the platform scales.
The roadmap for improving our ability to add new signals, support new use cases, and deliver consistent value across Coalition's products.

What You'll Do

Develop a clear product vision for how Coalition collects, interprets, and delivers cyber-risk intelligence.
Work with Engineering and Data to improve the coverage, accuracy, performance, and reliability of our scanning capabilities.
Partner with Underwriting, Actuarial, Security, and customer-facing teams to understand their needs and translate them into products and capabilities.
Decide which problems to solve first and make thoughtful trade-offs between new functionality and improvements to quality, scale, and reliability.
Define success metrics and use quantitative and qualitative feedback to guide product decisions.
Create simple, reusable ways for teams and customers to access and understand risk data.
Lead product discovery, write requirements, shape solutions with design and engineering, and guide initiatives from concept through launch.
Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
Help the team apply AI and automation thoughtfully.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of product management experience, including work on technical, data-intensive, platform, infrastructure, security, or developer-facing products.
Experience building products that serve multiple users or teams with different needs and priorities and a track record of partnering effectively with Engineering, Data, Design, and business stakeholders.
Strong product judgment and the ability to turn complex technical problems into clear strategies and practical roadmaps.
Comfort working with data quality, reliability, APIs, analytics, and systems that produce probabilistic or imperfect information.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clarity in ambiguous situations.
An analytical mindset and a willingness to engage deeply with both customer problems and technical details.
A bias toward action, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.

Bonus Points

Experience with cybersecurity, attack-surface management, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, or security operations.
Familiarity with large-scale data collection, distributed systems, data platforms, or developer tools.
Daily fluency with AI tools and a point of view on how AI can improve product development and security outcomes.

If you are excited by the opportunity to make complex cyber-risk data more accurate, understandable, and useful, we would love to hear from you.

We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Program & Project Delivery

Partner with Finance, business stakeholders, Digital Technology, vendors, and implementation partners to define scope, objectives, requirements, and success criteria.
Develop and manage implementation plans, timelines, dependencies, risks, mitigation strategies, and key delivery milestones.

Business Process & Solution Design

Description

Senior Product Manager

Product Team

Location: Fully Remote – U.S. Only

Travel: Less than 10%

Salary: $150,000–$160,000 base salary + annual bonus eligibility

Schedule: Monday–Friday

What Good Care Looks Like

Good care is specific. It is the right medication, for the right person, at the exact right time, and someone following up to make sure it actually worked.

That follow-through is where the system usually breaks down, and it is where Clarest steps in. We manage medication for patients across long-term care, assisted living, and at home, building the technology that keeps all three connected so no one gets handed off and forgotten.

None of that happens without the people doing it, which is why we hold ourselves to the same standard with our own. Paid time off increases the longer you are here, life insurance is company-paid, and for associates who enroll in our health plan, a dedicated nurse advocate and no-cost telehealth extend to eligible dependents as well. Careers here move in more directions than most people expect, and many of our leaders started in the roles we are hiring for now.

Build The Next Generation Of Medication Management Technology

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll help shape and build the next generation of Clarest Path—our medication management software designed to help care teams drive better outcomes for patients. You'll own meaningful product areas from discovery through launch, working closely with Engineering, Design, Clinical, Client Success, and our customers to turn complex problems into simple, scalable software.

This is a hands-on product role with real ownership. You'll help define what we build, why we're building it, and how we bring it to life. You'll lead discovery, develop product strategy, write requirements and PRDs, prioritize the roadmap, partner closely with Engineering, and drive products and capabilities through launch and adoption.

We're looking for a Product Manager who enjoys building, not just maintaining. You don't need to have built an entire platform from scratch, but you should have experience taking a new product or significant product capability from an idea or ambiguous problem through development and launch—and be excited to do more of that here.

This is an opportunity to join a startup-like product environment within a growing healthcare organization, where you can run with ideas, make meaningful decisions, and help shape a product with significant room to grow.

What You’ll Do

You'll help shape, build, and scale the next generation of Clarest Path—turning complex healthcare and medication management challenges into products that are useful, scalable, and designed around the people who use them.

Own product areas from discovery through launch, defining the problem, shaping the solution, partnering with Engineering and Design, and driving delivery through adoption.

Lead discovery with users, customers, and internal stakeholders to understand needs, workflows, pain points, and opportunities—and translate those insights into clear product direction.

Develop product strategy and roadmap priorities by balancing user needs, business objectives, technical feasibility, and available resources.

Write clear product requirements and PRDs, define acceptance criteria, prioritize backlogs, and help Engineering understand both the what and the why behind the work.

Build new software and product capabilities, with a strong focus on net-new experiences and expanding the capabilities of Clarest Path.

Help shape the evolution of Path from its current capabilities toward a broader, scalable software platform—including opportunities across patient, provider, client, and AI-enabled experiences.

Partner closely with Engineering and Product Design throughout discovery, development, testing, and launch.

Participate in sprint planning, refinement, standups, retrospectives, and release planning while helping the team make thoughtful tradeoffs around scope, timing, and technical complexity.

Use product judgment and data to make decisions, rather than simply responding to the loudest request.

Combine quantitative product metrics with qualitative customer and user feedback to evaluate opportunities, measure adoption, identify gaps, and determine what should happen next.

Build strong relationships across the organization, bringing together Engineering, Clinical, Client Success, commercial teams, and other stakeholders around a shared product direction.

Communicate decisions clearly, surface risks early, and influence without relying on formal authority.

Identify opportunities to make the product more scalable and valuable, including opportunities to expand Path into new client and user segments and potentially support a broader licensed SaaS offering.

Look beyond individual feature requests to understand the underlying problem and determine how we can build solutions that work across users, clients, and workflows.

Stay curious about emerging technology and AI, identifying where AI-enabled capabilities can create meaningful product value while maintaining appropriate human and clinical judgment.

Take ownership. You'll have significant autonomy and are expected to bring ideas, challenge assumptions, make decisions, and move work forward—while knowing when to pull others in, raise a red flag, or ask for input.

What We’re Looking For

5+ years of experience in Product Management, with a track record of owning software products or significant product capabilities.

Experience taking products or capabilities from discovery through launch, including defining the problem, developing requirements, partnering with Engineering, and driving delivery.

Experience building new software products or significant new product capabilities, rather than primarily maintaining or enhancing mature products.

Strong product strategy and judgment, with the ability to form a point of view, prioritize opportunities, and make thoughtful tradeoffs.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional partners and clearly communicate product decisions, priorities, and tradeoffs.

Highly organized and comfortable working independently in an environment with ambiguity, changing priorities, and significant ownership.

Technical product fluency—comfortable partnering with Engineering, understanding technical concepts and tradeoffs, and translating product needs into clear requirements.

Curiosity and practical understanding of how AI and emerging technologies can be incorporated into meaningful product experiences.

Bonus Points If You Have

Healthcare technology, healthcare services, pharmacy technology, or experience working in a regulated healthcare environment.

Experience with SaaS, platform, multi-tenant, or enterprise software products, particularly products used by external customers or multiple user groups.

Experience building products or capabilities for clinical, pharmacy, medication management, patient, provider, or other healthcare workflows.

Experience with Medication Therapy Management (MTM), medication adherence, Medicare Advantage quality programs, Stars, HEDIS, care management, patient outreach, or clinical call center workflows.

Experience building AI-enabled product capabilities or determining where AI can appropriately solve a user or business problem.

Experience taking a product into new customer segments, markets, or use cases, including expanding an existing platform into a broader SaaS offering.

You’ll Be Successful If You Have

A builder’s mindset. You’re energized by creating something new, comfortable starting with ambiguity, and willing to get into the details to turn an idea into a real product.

Strong product judgment. You can separate the problem from the requested solution, ask the right questions, weigh tradeoffs, and make thoughtful decisions about what to build—and what not to build.

Ownership and initiative. You don’t wait for someone else to define the next step. You can independently move work forward, recognize when something needs attention, and know when to bring others in.

Curiosity about users. You genuinely want to understand how people work, what makes their jobs easier or harder, and what they actually need before jumping to a solution.

The ability to influence without authority. You can bring Engineering, Design, Clinical, Client Success, and other stakeholders together around a shared direction—even when priorities or perspectives differ.

Strong opinions without ego. You’re comfortable advocating for your perspective, challenging assumptions, and changing your mind when the data, users, or team point you in a different direction.

An organized, hands-on approach. You can move between strategy and execution—thinking about the big picture one moment and digging into a PRD, backlog, workflow, or product decision the next.

A genuine interest in building products that matter. You’re excited by the opportunity to shape Clarest Path, solve meaningful healthcare problems, and help turn a growing product into something that can scale.

Physical Requirements

Remote Role

Ability to remain seated and perform computer-based work for extended periods.

Ability to communicate clearly through phone, video conferencing, and other digital communication platforms.

Ability to participate in virtual and in-person meetings and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Ability to review detailed product requirements, documentation, workflows, and technical information for extended periods.

Ability to occasionally move throughout an office environment as needed for meetings, collaboration, or other work-related activities.

What We Offer

Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (plans starting as low as $13.73 per pay period)

Free Virtual Care and Telemedicine Services

Paid Time Off

401(k) with Company Match

Company-Paid Life Insurance

Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA)

Employee Referral Bonuses

Pet Insurance

Legal Insurance

Ready to Apply?

We are building something worth staying for. Good care for patients, real support for the people who deliver it, and room to grow into more than the role you came in for. Apply today.
